event.text: I recommend a Counsel clinician review your refill request in this thread, with a same-day service-hours target. Refills need a prescriber, who will confirm which product you take and your health history first. If you develop chest pain or trouble breathing, or sudden severe headache that peaks within seconds, weakness or trouble speaking, call 911. For new calf pain or swelling alone, arrange same-day medical assessment.
